context.person: A person using a grocery delivery service
context.user_goal: Approve or reject the proposed replacement before the timer expires.

product_state.preceding_state: A requested brand of baby formula is unavailable and the shopper proposed a different size of the same formula.
product_state.current_state: The requested 680 g container is unavailable. The proposed replacement is two 340 g containers.
known_facts: The requested 680 g container is unavailable.
The proposed replacement is two 340 g containers.
The replacement costs $3 more in total.
Approval is needed within 12 minutes or the item will be skipped.
forbidden_claims: The replacement has the same price.
Rejecting the replacement cancels the entire order.

current_content.title: Heads up!
current_content.body: Open the app for more information.

challenge: Rewrite the mobile push notification so the person can understand grocery substitution needs approval, the material consequence, and the available next action or recovery without unsupported claims.

constraints.character_counting_rule: Count spaces, numbers, and punctuation as characters.

interaction_contract.secondary_action: Let the 12-minute window expire and skip only this item.
interaction_contract.consequence_to_preserve: Approval adds $3 to the order; no response skips the formula.
interaction_contract.recovery_to_preserve: Approve or reject the proposed replacement before the timer expires.

rationale_requirements: Explain how the wording represents the established product state without adding facts.
Explain how the material consequence and recovery remain visible.
Explain how each action or instruction matches its documented effect.
Report the character count for every candidate field.
Name unresolved questions instead of inventing policy, timing, certainty, or reassurance.
